lernapps.github.io.message:
feat(nav): link the tooling home page next to "App bauen"

## Intent

People who build an app should find what lernapps provides to build easier and faster.

## Key changes

- The top-level navigation gets an entry after "App bauen": "Bauhilfen" in German, "Build tools" in English, both to the English-only /tooling/.
- /tooling/ is a known site of the shared frame, so the link resolves and is marked current on the tooling pages.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Replaced by a link in the body of the build page in i005.
